ingredientSections.heading: Churro Assembly
items: ¼ Cup egg replacer (like Bob’s Red Mill Egg Replacer available at Vegan Supply page 190 or flaxmeal page 206)

ingredientSections.heading: Deep Frying & Coating
items: Canola, sunflower, extra light olive, grapeseed or similar high smoke point oil

methodSections.heading: Rice Pudding
steps: Add the coconut milk, rice and cardamom to a large pot and bring to boil. Stir regularly to avoid scorching.
Reduce the heat, add the sugar and vanilla extract and simmer until it thickens into a pudding consistency.
Stir through the cinnamon and a pinch of salt. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary.
Allow to completely cool for several hours or overnight.

methodSections.heading: Deep Frying & Coating
steps: Combine the sugar and cinnamon together in bowl and set aside
Half fill a medium-sized saucepan with a high smoke point oil and heat over medium-high heat until temperature reaches 190°C (375°F) on cooking thermometer.
Carefully lower the pudding balls, one at a time, into the oil frying only up to 6 balls at at time so the oil’s temperature doesn’t drop too much.
When they are golden brown and start to float, remove them with a slotted spoon and drain on a cooling rack and/or paper towel.
Toss the balls in the cinnamon sugar and serve with a scoop of your favourite vegan ice cream, or coconut whip cream.

methodSections.heading: Churro Assembly
steps: Use a small ice cream scoop to portion the rice pudding mixture onto a baking sheet. Set aside. In batches using a food processor, grind the corn flakes into a coarse meal. Place in large mixing bowl. Set aside. In a blender, blend 4 cups of water with the egg replacer. Set aside.
Set up a dredging station in the following order: pudding balls, egg replacer, corn flake powder.

Place 10 balls at a time into the egg replacer ensuring they are well coated. Roll each ball in the corn flake powder, ensuring they are consistently coated. Then place the coated balls on a parchment-lined baking tray.
Repeat until all the pudding balls are coated.
